scope: External MCP HTTP client, authorized production account, and internal chat request. No production code/configuration changes.

passed: unauthenticated requests receive 401 with resource metadata challenge

findings.observation: The same question through the non-streaming /api/trpc/chat.send API returned HTTP 500 on three completed attempts. The Worker error log confirmed INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR with error name Error. The browser UI streaming route was not tested.
findings.cause: Not established; MCP migration causality is not proven.
findings.consequence: The production equivalence check failed: the internal non-streaming API returned an error while external MCP returned evidence.

findings.observation: New production default API keys have rateLimitMax=10 and rateLimitTimeWindow=86400000. Initialization/notification/GET/tool-list requests also consume the key budget.
findings.additional_observation: Controlled real-HTTP exhaustion returned 401 UNAUTHORIZED / Invalid API key, rather than an explicit rate-limit response.

findings.observation: After tools/list, SDK callTool(create_course) with a read-only key threw -32602 output-schema mismatch. A direct HTTP call confirmed the server correctly returned isError=true and structuredContent {status:403,code:FORBIDDEN}.
findings.consequence: The SDK validates structured error content against the success schema and hides the intended public domain error.

findings.observation: inspect_clip returned status unavailable / Visual evidence is not available for this video yet. The authorized account had 73 videos, including 16 uploaded videos; none had visual_processing ready or processing metadata.
findings.consequence: No successful real-provider visual recognition was verified in production. Controlled fixture-based visual execution passed.

privacy: No credentials, account identifiers, video identifiers, private titles, transcripts, or image payloads are included in this report.
